body.name: Directed coupled chart cover
body.construction: \(\operatorname{Cover}_{\mathcal I}(G,H)\) holds exactly when every \(C\in\mathcal D_G\) admits \(D\in\mathcal D_H\), a surjection \(f:U_C\twoheadrightarrow U_D\), and nonzero \(a_i\) such that \(C_{:,i}=a_iD_{:,f(i)}\) for every \(i\in U_C\) and \(T_S(C)=T_S(D)\) for every \(S\in\mathcal I\).
